title: 🌳️ Dashboard command tree
description: 🎛️ The wizard command tree the dashboard discovers at boot: one node per wizard step, a leaf carrying either the process the pseudo-terminal window runs or the repo-domain action the Rust domain crates answer in process. `semio command-tree --dump-tree` prints exactly this document.

CommandNode.description: 🌳️ One wizard step. A node without `children` is a leaf and carries a `leaf`.

key.description: 🔑️ The stable, emoji-free key the wizard path is built from.

children.description: 🌿️ The next wizard step, sorted by verb rank at the root and alphabetically below it.

ProcessLeaf.description: ▶️ A process spawned into a pseudo-terminal window.

cwd.description: 📁️ Repository-relative working directory, forward-slashed; empty for the repository root.

RepoLeaf.description: 🦑️ A repo-domain operation the Rust domain crates answer in process; `goArgv` states the same operation for the Go implementation, which `SEMIO_REPO_IMPLEMENTATION=go` spawns instead.

action.description: 🔑️ The action key: a bare name, or `<name>:<argument>` for a ticket or an analysis scope.
